description:
Player props across the catalog's games of one league, one row per market: player, stat and line. NFL files props on a game's -player-props and -first-td-scorer child events and NBA on the game event; this reads both, so a caller does not walk list_games and then each game's markets. Each row carries player.name (the provider groupItemTitle before its first ": ", as the event page shows it; null with player_unavailable_reason when the provider stored no title), stat (the provider sportsMarketType), line (null for a yes/no prop such as an anytime touchdown), title, group_item_title, both outcomes with labels and CLOB token ids, status, resolved_at, and the game's game_event_slug, starts_at and competitors. Polymarket does not name a player's team. Rows are ordered by game slug, stat, player, line.

Args:
  - league (string, required): league tag as list_games coverage.leagues spells it, for example nfl or nba
  - starts_after / starts_before (string, optional): RFC 3339 kickoff bounds; a game with no published kickoff is excluded whenever either is set
  - player (string, optional): part of player.name, ignoring case and accents (jokic matches Nikola Jokić)
  - stat (string[], optional): provider sportsMarketType values to keep, for example passing_yards or points. Repeat the key or pass an array
  - status (string, optional): active (default), closed, or all
  - limit (number, 1-200, default 50)
  - cursor (string, optional): opaque prp_v1_ cursor from next_cursor, sent with the same filters
  - expand (string[], optional): quotes adds a quote to every outcome, the same object list_game_markets returns: the cached display price with its basis and observation time, and the cached best bid and ask. The board opens no live book, so a prop the CLOB watcher does not stream has no book (book_unavailable_reason not_streamed); its price is fetched behind the response when no cache holds one, so a later read finds it. Adds 1 to the cost

Returns: data, has_more, next_cursor, league, as_of (when the game catalog was assembled), coverage and meta. Read coverage.sources_unavailable before trusting a short or empty page: it names each game catalog source (<sport>:<half>, as list_games coverage does) that could carry the league's games and did not answer for this read, and the page can be missing that source's games until a later read. A page can hold fewer than limit rows, or none, while has_more is true: a read that has not filled its page stops after about 100 ms of prop reads (a player filter that matches few rows) and resumes on the next page, and a child event out of scope is dropped. Follow next_cursor while has_more is true. An unknown league is invalid_query. A known league with no games in the window is an empty page.
